content.text: Victor Martinez Home Talent Victor Martinez MLB Catcher Add to wishlist × Select which wishlist you want to add Victor Martinez to Select wishlist Create a New WishList Save Book Victor Martinez Víctor Martínez, famously known as “V-Mart,” was a Venezuelan MLB designated hitter and catcher. Throughout his sixteen-year career in the MLB, Martínez played for the Cleveland Indians, Boston Red Sox, and Detroit Tigers. During his time in the MLB, Martínez was considered one of the greatest hitters of his generation, with 246 home runs, 1,178 RBI’s, 2,153 hits while batting an average of .295.
